title: The Cocktail Hostesses
writer: Stephen C. Apostolof, Edward D. Wood Jr.
actors: Rene Bond, Terri Johnson, Harvey Shain
plot: Toni is a secretary who is tired of not making much money, even though she is sleeping with her boss. Her girlfriend convinces her to take a job as a cocktail hostess, where she can make a lot of money in tips, and meet a lot of men.
